Oracle Fusion Financials 26D: what's new

26D is the next Oracle Fusion Cloud quarterly update. Oracle's 26D What's New documents for this area list 73 features: 6 on by default, 10 on by default with potential setup, 46 setup required, 10 opt-in, 1 needing another action, per Oracle's "Action to Enable" column. See all 73 →

We track 25 Financials changes in 26D, out of 73 features (our count) in Oracle's 26D What's New documents for this area. 16 of them are delivered switched on; 9 need setup or an opt-in before anyone can use them.

Oracle sources: Financials 26D What's New · Risk Management (Classic) 26D What's New · Risk Management (Redwood) 26D What's New · Self Service Financials 26D What's New

Impact on upgrade is our editorial rating of how much a change affects existing users and testing; Oracle scale is Oracle's own rating. Always confirm details on the linked Oracle page.

Delivered switched on (16)

Automated Zengin master data upload for bulk maintenance of banks and bank branches in Japan

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically on (setup may apply)FinancialsFinancials · Manage Payment ConfigurationIdea Lab
Upload Japan Zengin bank master data for bulk maintenance of banks and bank branches without the need to manually prepare and consolidate multiple CSV files before import.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

Depreciation adjustment for tax book

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onFinancialsFinancials · Asset Acquisition, Maintenance, and Lease
The tax authority may finalize or confirm the depreciation allowable for a fiscal year several months after the tax book fiscal year has closed. In the meantime, tax book periods must be closed and advanced to the next fiscal year to allow ongoing transaction processing.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

ISO Positive Pay File for Voided Checks

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onFinancialsFinancials · Payment Processing
Oracle Fusion Cloud Payments now supports including voided check details in ISO 20022 positive pay files for JPMorgan Chase and PNC banks. Positive pay files help banks validate checks presented for payment against check information provided by an organization.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Payables Period Close Workspace

Impact on upgrade: mediumOracle scale: Larger scaleAutomatically onFinancialsFinancials · Payables AgentAgentic app
Use the Payables Period Close Workspace to achieve a timely, controlled, and explainable Payables close. For the selected ledger and accounting period, the workspace brings together invoice, payment, and period status to establish the current close posture, identify what is preventing progress, and direct attention to the work that matters most.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Larger scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Electronic Filing of Forms 1099-MISC, 1099-NEC, 1099-G, and 1099-INT using Information Returns Intake System

Impact on upgrade: lowAutomatically onFinancialsFinancials · Payables Invoice Processing
File Forms 1099-MISC, 1099-NEC, 1099-G and 1099-INT electronically in high volumes through the IRS Information Returns Intake System taxpayer portal. The platform enables online filing of the Form 1099 series at no additional cost.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Report · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Access Global Conditions and Access Entitlements reports

Impact on upgrade: lowAutomatically onFinancialsRisk Management (Classic) · Transactional Business Intelligence for Risk Management
Two pre-built reports, the Access Global Conditions Report and the Access Entitlements Report, list all access global conditions and all access entitlements with their access points. Oracle says you can open them from the Oracle Transactional Business Intelligence (OTBI) catalog under /Shared Folders/Risk Management/Advanced Access Controls/Administration/Report Components.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Report · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Define reusable Algorithm Filters

Impact on upgrade: lowOracle scale: Larger scaleAutomatically on (setup may apply)FinancialsRisk Management (Redwood) · AlgorithmsRedwood Platform
Algorithm Filters are reusable definitions that specify the data an algorithm keeps or removes during evaluation. They support Sensitive Access Monitor, Segregation of Duties (SoD) Access Monitor, Transaction Monitor, and Change Tracking algorithm types.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Larger scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

Define reusable User-Defined Access Paths

Impact on upgrade: lowOracle scale: Larger scaleAutomatically on (setup may apply)FinancialsRisk Management (Redwood) · AlgorithmsRedwood Platform
Define User-Defined Access Paths (UDAPs) for a selected data source and reuse them in access algorithms, entitlements, and filters. Reusing UDAPs eliminates the need to define the same access paths repeatedly.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Larger scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

Generate Risk and Security Snapshot Reports

Impact on upgrade: lowOracle scale: Larger scaleAutomatically on (setup may apply)FinancialsRisk Management (Redwood) · Snapshot ReportRedwood Platform
Use Risk and Security Snapshot Reports to view the snapshot definitions available to you and generate reports from their configured scope. Each snapshot definition groups one or more business processes and the Oracle-managed or customer-defined algorithms to analyze.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Larger scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

Internal Control record management

Impact on upgrade: lowOracle scale: Larger scaleAutomatically on (setup may apply)FinancialsRisk Management (Redwood) · Internal ControlsRedwood Platform
Internal Controls provides a central repository for documented internal controls. Each control record includes a control definition, related processes, risks, categories, stakeholders, comments, attachments, activities, related algorithms, and related internal controls.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Larger scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

Manage access entitlements for access algorithms

Impact on upgrade: lowOracle scale: Larger scaleAutomatically on (setup may apply)FinancialsRisk Management (Redwood) · AlgorithmsRedwood Platform
Define and manage access entitlements used by access algorithms, such as Sensitive Access Monitors and Segregation of Duties (SoD) Access Monitors. An entitlement defines access points and supports flexible logical evaluation.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Larger scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

Monitor and schedule Risk Management jobs

Impact on upgrade: lowOracle scale: Larger scaleAutomatically on (setup may apply)FinancialsRisk Management (Redwood) · Common Risk ManagementRedwood Platform
Use the Monitor Jobs page to find and follow jobs that run in Risk Management. Search and filter jobs by status, run by, submission date, and job type, and sort the list by submission date.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Larger scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

My Access Certification Task management

Impact on upgrade: lowOracle scale: Larger scaleAutomatically on (setup may apply)FinancialsRisk Management (Redwood) · Access CertificationRedwood Platform
Use My Access Certification Tasks to complete work assigned to you during an access certification campaign. Access certifications help organizations review whether users should retain or remove assigned role access.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Larger scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

My Internal Control Certification Tasks management

Impact on upgrade: lowOracle scale: Larger scaleAutomatically on (setup may apply)FinancialsRisk Management (Redwood) · Internal ControlsRedwood Platform
My Internal Control Certification Tasks gives assigned certifiers a focused workspace for completing their internal control certification tasks. Internal control certifications help organizations verify that controls and processes are effective, compliant, and adequately mitigate risk.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Larger scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

Receive the Risk Cloud Daily Digest

Impact on upgrade: lowOracle scale: Small scaleAutomatically onFinancialsRisk Management (Redwood) · Common Risk ManagementRedwood Platform
Risk Cloud Daily Digest consolidates relevant Risk Management activity into a daily email. The Risk Cloud Notifications job is scheduled automatically to generate the daily digest email.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Small scale · Action to enable: None · Oracle source

Reference Data management

Impact on upgrade: lowOracle scale: Larger scaleAutomatically on (setup may apply)FinancialsRisk Management (Redwood) · Common Risk ManagementRedwood Platform
Use the Reference Data tab in the Reference Data and Settings module to manage reference-data attributes used by internal controls and other Risk Management capabilities.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": Larger scale · Action to enable: Potential Setup · Oracle source

Asset Acquisition Cost Analyst

Impact on upgrade: lowOff until set upFinancialsFinancials · AssetsAI agent
The Asset Acquisition Cost Analyst helps to analyze the fixed asset acquisition from source systems and direct capitalization. This analyst helps asset accountants summarize additions and adjustments by source system, break down results across key business dimensions, and drill down to asset-level and invoice-level details to support reconciliation, audit, and asset acquisition analysis.
Oracle's "Impact to Existing Processes": None · Action to enable: Setup Required · Oracle source

Asset Additions Assistant

Impact on upgrade: lowOff until set upFinancialsFinancials · AssetsAI agent
The Asset Additions Assistant simplifies the asset addition process through an intuitive conversational experience that helps fixed asset accountants submit, review, and process asset additions.

Use the Oracle Visual Builder Add-in for Excel to manage budget-level control budgets. The Federal Ledger Options VB Excel template is available from the Manage Federal Ledger Options task in Setup and Maintenance work area under functional area U.S.

Bulk transaction printing and usability improvements in Bill Management

Select multiple transactions from the Account Overview page to print as PDF files and download as a zip file. Use the expanded search, sorting, and filtering options on the Account Overview and Transaction History pages to find intended transactions more quickly.

The Capital Expenditure Planning Analyst supports capital expenditure planning through a guided conversational experience.
